faqs.question: What is Microsoft Power Pages?
faqs.answer: Microsoft Power Pages is a low-code platform for building secure, data-driven business websites quickly and efficiently.

faqs.question: Can I integrate Power Pages with other Microsoft services?
faqs.answer: Yes, Power Pages integrates seamlessly with Microsoft Dataverse, Power BI, Power Apps, and other Power Platform services.

faqs.question: Is Power Pages suitable for non-developers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Power Pages is built for both non-developers and professional developers using intuitive tools and pro-dev extensions.

faqs.question: Can I customize Power Pages using code?
faqs.answer: Yes, developers can extend Power Pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Liquid templates, and VS Code integration.

faqs.question: Does Power Pages support user authentication?
faqs.answer: Yes, it supports Azure AD, Microsoft Accounts, and external identity providers for secure login.
